main_measure.name: mean signed 72-bar excess return on grid bars with |forecast| >= 10 in mean_reversion
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: slope of signed excess return on |forecast|, grid bars in regime with forecast != 0

reading: The coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean over all its non-overlapping grid returns across all windows, grid bars without a bar t+72 in the same window are dropped, and the plan's minimum counts are applied as 'not observable' per the workflow.
